items.title: David N. Baker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The same thing with the Serenade [Serenade for Tenor, Horn, and Strings] by Benjamin Britten

ctx.x: It’s for clarinet, bassoon, trumpet, percussion, violin, and contrabass; and I wrote Homage a l’Histoire as an accompaniment [piece], so whenever they do that work, they can do my work, too. The same thing with the Serenade [Serenade for Tenor, Horn, and Strings] by Benjamin Britten, which is for a high voice, usually tenor . . .
